moment: The shadow points toward the temple road. Then toward the alley where the soot-gray stray vanished. Two directions. Two warnings. Or two invitations. The acolyte finally looks at you. “Whatever you choose, do it before my shadow chooses for us.”
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, strong black ink, monochrome, no colour. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
